text:
CHECK BURST P4c-S-cast-x — Run C-3 matrix cell CAST × S: cut ONE registered one-shot from its Grok clip at EXPLICIT native indices with the frozen cut functions, then measure it with FROZEN gates — REPORT ONLY (no verdicts; every band here is a proposal). task_id "P4c-S-cast-x".

Inputs (read-only): the clip /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/runs/C-3/xvideo/in/S_cast_v2.mp4 (v2; 768×1168, 24 fps, 145 frames, #00ff00 plate). Frozen tools under /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/ — read the docstrings, run them, never modify them: oracle/video_cut.py (CLI), oracle/bands_from_exemplar.py (measure, score), oracle/bands_proposed.json, gates/g6_seam.py (evaluate, g6c), gates/g1_height.py, gates/head_pitch.py (evaluate), gates/coherence.py (evaluate(frames_dir, None)), gates/matte_quality.py (rim_luma_excess). `python3 - <<'PY'` glue that imports these modules (sys.path.insert(0, '/Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst')) is fine; no new tool files; PIL + numpy + scipy only; ffmpeg at /opt/homebrew/bin/ffmpeg.

STEP 1 — EXPLICIT CUT (conductor, ledger R-C3-17; K3p-xv-cut-04 precedent — there is NOTHING to detect or decide): the 8 native frame indices are [14, 32, 51, 58, 69, 80, 93, 102] (explicit key poses from a FULL-RESOLUTION staff-tip series (R-C3-16 rule) — the tool's cast detection ran on the low-resolution tip proxy that tracks the hair). Using the frozen module functions only (`from oracle import video_cut as vc`): vc.split(clip, <a temp dir under out/tmp>, t_max_s=99) → take native frame 0 (the rest frame) and the 8 listed native frames → vc.matte_frames(those paths, edge_mode='clamp') → vc.register([rest] + the 8, anchor_index=0) (ONE uniform scale + ONE translation from the rest frame: height 240, sole 399, cx 255.5) → write out/cut/frames/rest/S/rest_S.png and out/cut/frames/cast/S/cast_S_00..07.png, out/cut/sheets/cast_S_strip.png (frames on #3a3f4a, numbered), out/cut/registration.json = {"kind":"cast","direction":"S","clip":"S_cast_v2.mp4","fps_out":20,"n":8,"indices_native":[14, 32, 51, 58, 69, 80, 93, 102],"selection_authority":"R-C3-17 explicit key poses","transform":<from register>,"splice":<vc.splice_check on the 145 native matted frames if cheap, else null with reason>}. Delete out/tmp before returning. If a listed frame cannot be matted, report it and continue with the rest.
STEP 2 — measure (report only) into out/checks.json = {"cell":"S_cast","clip":"S_cast_v2.mp4","clip_version":"v2","flags":[],"cut":<out/cut/registration.json>,"results":[result envelopes]}. Frames = out/cut/frames/cast/S/cast_S_NN.png; rest = out/cut/frames/rest/S/rest_S.png. Each item below is one or more envelopes; if a call raises, append an envelope with value null, passed null and notes = the exception text, and continue:
  a) values, diagnostic = bands_from_exemplar.measure(...) — no measure() kind exists for one-shots — skip a); every scored envelope must carry passed = null.
  b) g6_seam.evaluate(frames) (G6 literal / G6b).
  c) G1 size stability: g1_height.evaluate(frame_i, rest) for every frame → one envelope with value = the max fraction and the per-frame list in notes.
  d) head_pitch.evaluate(frames, rest, fps=20) — report.
  e) coherence.evaluate(frames_dir, None) — report.
  f) matte_quality.rim_luma_excess(frame) per frame → one envelope, value = mean.
  g) closure: alpha-weighted mean |RGB| between frame 0 and frame 7, and between frame 7 and the rest frame (two envelopes, unit rgb_mad).
STEP 3 — sheets for the separate transcriber: out/grid.png = the 8 registered frames in a grid of 4 columns, 256-px cells on #3a3f4a, each numbered 0…7 in its top-left corner; out/first_second.png = the clip's native frames at t = 0.0, 0.5 and 1.0 s (ffmpeg select, no matte) side by side, each scaled to 384 px tall, labelled t=0.0 / t=0.5 / t=1.0.
No image_gen. No writes outside out/. No web. calls_used must be 0. BUDGET: the cut takes ~30 s; everything else is quick — deliver within 12 minutes.
RETURN: receipt task_id "P4c-S-cast-x"; images []; files: out/checks.json, out/grid.png, out/first_second.png, out/cut/registration.json, out/cut/series.json, every out/cut/frames/** PNG and the strip, each with sha256; status DELIVERED / DELIVERED_WITH_CONCERNS / FAILED; concerns naming anything not computed. Never PASS/FAIL.
